title: Reminder fixes validated; phone delivery needs testing
summary: TypeScript, source lint and 37 selected tests pass. Generated web and Android JavaScript bundles pass syntax checks; native bytecode and real-device delivery remain unverified.

changes.detail: Added a regression test proving UTC-offset changes replace the native weekly schedule once without duplicate rescheduling.
Recorded validation of the linked reminder reliability changes and the remaining device/build limitations.

validation.name: Focused lint
validation.detail: The three changed application TS/TSX files passed ESLint. Repository configuration ignores CJS tests.

validation.name: Regression tests
validation.detail: 37 unique tests passed across wellness, browser reminders, journey clock and history suites, including a subsequent 24-test wellness run with the added offset regression.

validation.name: Platform JavaScript artifacts
validation.detail: Expo --no-bytecode generated web and Android bundles and export metadata. Both emitted JS bundles passed node --check. The exporter has not returned an exit status, so a clean export-process completion is not claimed.

validation.name: Native bytecode
validation.detail: Windows denied execution of hermesc.exe. See the linked immutable failure report.

validation.name: Device delivery and visual QA
validation.detail: No real-device, background/closed-app, sound or battery-saving delivery test was performed. Browser delivery requires an open tab. No deployment or installation was performed.
